description: A red bar, the raster's full width and a quarter its height, turning clockwise about its own centre from 0 to 90 degrees over its length. Frame 0 rests horizontal across the middle. By frame 16 it is at 45 degrees, running from the upper left down to the lower right — the direction is the whole point, because an anticlockwise turn puts the bar on the other diagonal and fails here, and a quarter turn alone could not tell the two apart. By frame 31 it is all but upright. `native` fit, so the bar keeps its own shape and there is something asymmetric to turn: a uniform square would look identical at every right angle. A turn anchored anywhere but the layer's own centre swings it off the middle and fails.
